## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head e60c6ad8aa · card #37761 · area s2-ux · 2026-11-27T05:51Z

**L1 checklist**
- **Shape and checks.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 37824` flags one item, `all-checks`. The flagged run is a `PR-body guards` run (140330746592) that was cancelled by a later run of the same name. That later run, 140330878375, is a success on this head. Every other check-run is a success or an expected skip: 46 success, 15 skipped. `mergeable_state` is clean. 4 files. Patch changeset on `@object-ui/components`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **No contract face.** `record-recognisers.mjs --brief-template` exits 1 on the changed paths, so this seat record at `TIER_DEFAULT` is the review of record.
- **Diff read.** `AlertDialogContent` gains `[&>*]:min-w-0`, so its grid items can shrink below their min-content width. `AlertDialogTitle` and `AlertDialogDescription` gain `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`. `break-word` would not lower the min-content width, so this is the right property. A caller's own classes still merge last. The three edits are registered as local patches of the vendored shadcn file in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, and that gate is green.
- **`Fixes #37761` is right.** A title holding one 5,000-character token no longer widens the record-delete confirm past `max-w-lg`. The thread measured this in Chromium at 1440 px with the component's own compiled classes. Scroll width went from 51,248 px to 510 px, and the Cancel button from x 51,540 to x 778. A pin covers both the title and the description.
- **Changeset read sentence by sentence.** It matches the diff.
- **Governance.** `check-governed-merges.mjs`: not governed, 169 changed lines. Tier S.
- **No follow-up card.** The plain `Dialog` is left as it is. The card measured only the confirm dialog, and no case on `main` shows a plain dialog stretching.

Tier: S. Landing: ready + auto-merge by this stroke.
